description: Get the full text and tables of a specific Schedule of the Constitution of India (2026 Edition). Covers all 12 Schedules (First to Twelfth Schedule). Examples: get_constitution_schedule('Seventh') -> Union, State, and Concurrent Lists get_constitution_schedule('7') -> Same as 'Seventh' get_constitution_schedule('Eighth') -> Languages get_constitution_schedule('First') -> States and Union Territories
name: indian_legal_mcp_get_constitution_schedule
